steps.title: Choose the boundary: Keeping API schemas distinct from persistence entities

blocks.text: Persistence models map stored rows; public response models select client-facing fields. These contracts remain separate even for the same entity.
Define separate public input and output BaseModel classes. response_model=PublicOutput keeps persistence-only or sensitive fields from automatically becoming API fields.
For validation from object attributes, use model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) on the public model. The persistence class need not become the public schema.

right.alt_text: Separate public input and output omit storage-only fields. PublicOutput may validate attributes with ConfigDict(from_attributes=True).

blocks.text: The row carries storage-only processing state. Choose separate input and output fields; attribute-based validation does not authorize every attribute to become public.

_SUPPLIED_SCAFFOLD = 'import asyncio

from fastapi import FastAPI

from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

class FailureClass(Exception):
    pass

class FailedSession:
    def __init__(self): self.failed=True; self.rollback_calls=0
    async def rollback(self): self.failed=False; self.rollback_calls+=1
    async def reuse(self):
        assert not self.failed, "session has not recovered"

app=FastAPI()

@app.get("/conflict")
async def conflict():
    raise FailureClass("synthetic private uniqueness diagnostic")

async def check_recovery(initial_failed):
    async def run():
        s=FailedSession();s.failed=initial_failed
        try: await recover(s)
        except FailureClass:
            assert s.rollback_calls==1 and not s.failed
            return {'raised':'FailureClass','rollbacks':s.rollback_calls,'failed':s.failed,'initial_failed':initial_failed}
        raise AssertionError('Recovery must raise recognized failure after rollback')
    return await run()

from starlette.exceptions import HTTPException as StarletteHTTPException

from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

    raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="credential required", headers={"WWW-Authenticate":"Bearer"})

# Unchanged supplied runtime/scaffold source; edit only the learner region below.
_SUPPLIED_SCAFFOLD = 'from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException

from starlette.exceptions import HTTPException as StarletteHTTPException

from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

app=FastAPI()

@app.get("/fastapi-error")
async def fastapi_error():
    raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="credential required", headers={"WWW-Authenticate":"Bearer"})

@app.get("/starlette-error")
async def starlette_error():
    raise StarletteHTTPException(status_code=404, detail="not found")
'
exec(_SUPPLIED_SCAFFOLD, globals())
# BEGIN LEARNER EDITS
@app.exception_handler(StarletteHTTPException)
async def public_error(request, exception):
    # Contract: body contains only {"reason": public_reason}; approved reasons are credential required (401) and not found (404).
    public_reason = {401: "credential required", 404: "not found"}.get(exception.status_code, "The request could not be completed.")
    return JSONResponse(status_code=exception.status_code, content={"reason": public_reason}, headers=exception.headers)
# END LEARNER EDITS
